mainEntity.name: Do you deliver to Prince Edward County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Delivery and installation is $1,750 anywhere in Ontario, including the County.

mainEntity.name: Is a sauna a good addition to a rental property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many owners find it is. Check your municipal short-term rental rules and insurance first; we can help with specs and photos.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit in Prince Edward County?

acceptedAnswer.text: An accessory building over 10 m² typically needs a building permit, zoning setbacks apply, and electric saunas need an ESA permit. Waterfront lots may need conservation authority approval. We check before you order.

mainEntity.name: How much does delivery and installation cost in Prince Edward County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Delivery and installation is $1,750 anywhere in Ontario, including Prince Edward County. Delivery only is $450. HST is shown separately on every quote.

mainEntity.name: What heater size does my sauna need?

acceptedAnswer.text: We size every heater to the sauna's interior volume plus extra for glass. None of our saunas take less than a 6 kW heater; larger models use 9 to 10.5 kW electric or a wood stove where there's room for its clearances.
